source_identity.candidate_policy: One uncommitted, bounded, wire-identical prototype was applied atop the control commit and reverted after its directional gate failed.

exact_main.payload_shape: Direct fused IFFT_DIT4/FFT_DIT4 calls in the -march=native field translation unit.

leopard2.payload_shape: The AVX-512VL range entry calls the split radix-four implementation for large tiles; each ordinary split operation invokes four two-way kernels, while accumulated terminal stages invoke four pair callbacks per lane.

static_attribution.isa_result: The gap is not explained by an ISA mismatch. Exact main's -march=native code and Leopard2's isolated AVX-512VL backend both use 256-bit EVEX instructions and the expanded YMM register file.
static_attribution.assembly_input_retention: The assembly files are ignored machine-local diagnostics. Decision-bearing counts and conclusions are retained here.

openmp_diagnostic.purpose: Determine whether single-thread OpenMP runtime overhead alone can explain the 2.32 percent exact-main gap.
openmp_diagnostic.result: OpenMP-off is only about 0.1 percent faster directionally, far below the gap; reject an OpenMP-only production change.

candidate.hypothesis: The AVX-512VL expanded register file may make exact-main-style fused two-layer radix-four payloads profitable for large legacy-high tiles, reducing split passes and repeated table preparation.
candidate.scope: Legacy-high GF16 encode under the selected AVX-512 operation table. Large ordinary inverse and final forward radix-four stages were fused; the established final inverse split-XOR accumulator remained unchanged.
candidate.wire_identity: All four timed parity digests matched the control value 661175412a7efeaf.
candidate.interpretation: Large fusion is 8.36 percent slower directionally. The extra fused-kernel table pressure outweighs its reduced shard passes even with the expanded register file.

directional_method.purpose: Fast fail screen only; a clearly losing candidate does not justify consuming a quiet exact-main campaign.
limitations: No confidence interval or fail-closed SMT-sibling isolation gate was run.
The measurements ran while unrelated project work could use other cores.
The negative magnitude is much larger than the prior exact-main gap and every parity digest matched.

focused_asan_ubsan_tests.runtime_policy: ASan leak detection, halt-on-error, and abort-on-error; UBSan halt-on-error, abort-on-error, and stack traces

validation.fuzzing: Not run by request; this pass uses deterministic compatibility, direct-oracle, backend-KAT, and focused sanitizer tests.

conclusion.kill_decision: Do not promote large AVX-512 radix-four fusion or an OpenMP-only special case.
conclusion.remaining_actionable_hypothesis: If the residual 2.32 percent cell remains worth pursuing, use a separately reviewed codec-specialized whole-transform executor that combines direct intra-translation-unit calls, compact pre-expanded coefficient schedules, and serial control. Isolated callback, table-layout, tile-size, terminal-fusion, large-fusion, and OpenMP-only changes have each failed to provide enough headroom.
conclusion.scope_warning: That combined executor is materially larger than this bead's one-prototype limit and requires its own exact-main and neighboring-cell gate.
